dedupe_keys.name: using a snr digital twin for failure management

description: Velasco, Luis and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The method uses GNPy as a signal-to-noise digital twin, comparing measured transponder QoT with model estimates. Inverse analysis attributes deviations to amplifier noise figure or reduced WSS optical SNR and estimates those device parameters. Coverage includes experiments and simulated soft-failure detection/localisation. This adaptation is distinct from the general GNPy library linked in the catalogue. The source reports early degradation identification, but precise lead times and a public adaptation repository are unspecified. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
